name: Prehistoric Animal Museum
tagline: A calm 3D museum of prehistoric animals for children and parents — no ads, no analytics
description: Prehistoric Animal Museum is a quiet, free 3D world where children and grown-ups can explore 18 prehistoric animals — from Stegosaurus and T-Rex to Mosasaurus and Tupandactylus — in English or Simplified Chinese. Each exhibit offers a rotatable model and short narration, with a parent guide for the questions that follow. There is no account, no ads, and no analytics, and the site is responsive with keyboard navigation and reduced-motion support.
highlights: 18 prehistoric animals with rotatable 3D models and narration in EN and CN
Free, no account, no ads, no analytics scripts
Responsive with keyboard navigation and reduced-motion support
A calm alternative to chase-and-fight dinosaur content
curatorNote: "No winning or losing, just look at the animal." That sentence is the whole product. Thoughtful, accessible, and ad-free — a quiet gem built with obvious care.
